Variants.Content: The belief in the Seven Gods understands divinity as the seven aspects of the same deity: the Father symbolizes judgment, the Virgin symbolizes mercy, the warrior symbolizes courage, the girl symbolizes purity, the blacksmith symbolizes labor, the old woman symbolizes wisdom, and the stranger symbolizes death and the unknown. Nobles will attend weddings and weddings Formal ceremonies were used at crowning and funerals. Soldiers might only pray to warriors before going off to battle, while peasants told their plight to the Virgin, the blacksmith, or strangers. The Seven Gods are not seven sets of unrelated doctrines, but the same set of beliefs that explain different situations in life; different regions, classes and individuals will highlight different aspects.
